## Documentation Issue Type

<!-- Mark the relevant option with an "x" -->

- [ ] **Missing Documentation** - Information that should exist but doesn't
- [ ] **Incorrect Documentation** - Information that is wrong or outdated
- [ ] **Unclear Documentation** - Information that is confusing or hard to understand
- [ ] **Incomplete Documentation** - Information that exists but is missing details
- [ ] **New Documentation** - Request for documentation of a new topic
- [ ] **Typo / Grammar** - Minor text corrections needed
